decisions.reason: After several years and two years without website presence, the yogurt's initial award no longer offsets the low option value of keeping a likely minor variant in a narrow organic range.
Although it was introduced as a flagship cheese, its absence from later website communication suggests the market test has largely played out and further commitment is hard to justify.
This semi-hard cheese is close to existing capabilities but lacks any later visible traction, so the learning value of keeping the option open now appears limited.
A multi-variant spicy cheese line adds assortment complexity, and with no later sign of success management would likely reallocate resources to stronger core products or new trials.
The mild creamy soft cheese broadened the assortment, but by 2022 the uncertainty should be largely resolved and the missing later visibility points toward pruning.
Washed-rind soft cheese serves a narrower taste niche, and after prolonged non-observation its expected value is too low to merit keeping the option open.
